skills.name: Flowing Blood
skills.description:
Alice casts a sphere of blood energy in the target direction, dealing 400<font color='#27C0C7'>( +120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to enemies in its path.
<font color='#404495'>(Use Again)</font>: Alice immediately teleports to the blood sphere's location.
skills.tips: Alice fires a blood orb in the specified direction, dealing  points of Magic Damage to enemies. Using this skill again to immediately teleport to the orb's location.

skills.name: Blood Awe
skills.description:
Alice deals 200<font color='#27C0C7'>( +75% Total Magic Power)</font> plus 2.5<font color='#27C0C7'>( <1015 0.003 1>)</font>% of the target's Max HP as <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to nearby enemies and immobilizes them for 0.5s. After the immobilize effect ends, the targets will be slowed by 70% for 1.5s.
Creeps can only take up to 250 damage from the Max HP-based damage.
skills.tips: Alice deals points of Magic Damage to nearby enemies, immobilizing them for 1.2 seconds, then the enemies will be slowed for 2 seconds.

skills.name: Blood Ode
skills.description:
Alice enters the blood-draining state, consuming 60 Mana while dealing 30<font color='#27C0C7'>( +30% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to nearby enemies every 0.5s. She recovers 40<font color='#27C0C7'>( +30% Total Magic Power)</font> HP each time she damages an enemy hero (only 50% of that HP for other enemy units).
Each time this effect damages an enemy hero, the cooldown of <font color='#404495'>(Flowing Blood)</font> is reduced by 0.2s and the cooldown of <font color='#404495'>(Blood Awe)</font> is reduced by 0.5s.
skills.tips: Queen of the Apocalypse enters the blood-sucking state for the next 5 seconds, dealing  points of Magic Damage to surrounding enemies every 0.5 seconds while restoring  HP for herself.

skills.name: Blood Ancestry
skills.description:
Alice restores 1.5% Max Mana per second, which increases to 3% when in combat against enemy heroes.
Each time Alice levels up, her Movement Speed increases by 3 and Healing Received increases by 1%.
skills.tips: When a nearby minion dies, a blood orb is generated. Each blood orb absorbed permanently increases Alice's max HP . After absorbing  blood orbs, she will receive an additional upgrade of  Cooldown Reduction/ Spell Vamp/ movement speed.

items.name: Clock of Destiny
items.des: Unique Passive - Time: Gains 20 extra Max HP and 4 extra Magic Power every 20s, capped at 15 stacks.

items.name: Demon Boots
items.des: Unique Passive - Mysticism: Getting a kill or assist on an enemy Minion will restore 4% Mana. (An assist occurs when a Minion dies within 2s after taking damage from the hero.)

items.name: Ice Queen Wand
items.des: Unique Passive - Ice Bound: When a skill deals damage to an enemy hero, it will also slow them by 10% for 2s (stacks up to 3 times). This effect has a 1s cooldown.

items.name: Dominance Ice
items.des: Unique Passive - Arctic Cold: Reduces the Attack Speed of nearby enemy heroes to 70% of normal.

items.name: Oracle
items.des: Unique Passive - Bless: Received Shield and HP Regen effects are increased by 30%.

items.name: Glowing Wand
items.des: Unique Passive - Scorch: Burn targets for 3s, dealing Magic Damage equal to 1.5% of the target's Max HP per second.

builds.tips: Set Build ini adalah salah satu Build terbaik untuk Alice yang membutuhkan HP. Dengan jumlah HP nya yang banyak, Alice dapat bertahan lebih lama ketika melakukan Engage atau memasuki Team Fight.
